_meta.purpose: Seed batch of composite aspect pair hooks, mirroring fallback-hook/synastry-pair. Voice = the CONNECTION as a single subject (never two people, never 'bond'). Adapted from the natal aspect-pair cookbook meanings, re-voiced for a relationship chart. Full set is ~161 pairs x {soft, hard, conjunction}.
_meta.voice: the connection (single subject); body_you and body_they are identical because the subject is the relationship itself, not a viewer
_meta.style: no em dashes, plain language, banned-words clean, colon setup/payoff; use 'connection', never 'bond'
_meta.review: needs_review until owner approves rendered output in chat
